name: Samira Latef Hammoudi
source:
An Admiral of the Neo-Terran fleet who has set her eyes on the kingdom of Valdana.
Known for her aggressive tactics, she commands the battleship Yasant, one of the most feared vessels in the universe.
She's also a noblewoman, with her brother being the ruler of the Duchy of Hammoudi.
